questions.title: Approve Sabine's revised clue set?
questions.context: Sabine's seven location clues currently tend to state an ethical conclusion before giving the player observable evidence. This complete replacement set starts with ecology, tracks, routines, water access, cover, and calls before Sabine interprets them.
questions.recommendation: Review and approve these as one seven-page sequence. Individual lines may be named in the text box if only part of the set needs another pass.

reviewItems.label: Page 1
reviewItems.candidate: Bite the new shoots down at dusk and they stand above the old cut by morning. This place can answer feeding without pretending nothing was taken.

reviewItems.label: Page 2
reviewItems.candidate: Every shelter is occupied, and fresh tracks stop at the entrances before turning away. More creatures live here than one keeper could gather.

reviewItems.label: Page 3
reviewItems.candidate: Small grazers crowd the new growth. Larger tracks circle them, and scavengers follow what the hunt leaves behind. Feed one creature here and three others change their route.

reviewItems.label: Page 4
reviewItems.candidate: The same hollows are pressed flat each night while nearby ground goes untouched. Return often enough and absence becomes part of the pattern.

reviewItems.label: Page 5
reviewItems.candidate: Hoofprints, paws and dragging tails reach the water by different banks. No creature has to pass another's shelter to drink.

reviewItems.label: Page 6
reviewItems.candidate: There is open ground enough to approach and cover near enough to refuse. I could work here without making nearness the only safe choice.

reviewItems.label: Page 7
reviewItems.candidate: The same calls begin at the same interval, and the same paths fill soon after. They can learn when I return; that does not mean they must come.

choices.title: Approve exact set
choices.detail: Promote all seven clues exactly as shown.

choices.detail: Preserve the evidence-first direction but revise named lines.

reviewItems.label: Marrick · page 1
reviewItems.candidate: Boots land level here, whether the wearer is first or fifth in line. Hard ground can carry one instruction across several bodies.

reviewItems.label: Marrick · page 2
reviewItems.candidate: Five people could stand abreast and still point to both edges of the clearing. Wider, and a signal would scatter; narrower, and there would be no choice of position.

reviewItems.label: Marrick · page 3
reviewItems.candidate: The same gust reaches every place in the line. Watch longer and it becomes clear who must lean harder to keep it.

reviewItems.label: Marrick · page 4
reviewItems.candidate: The air barely changes temperature from one watch to the next. Fatigue will show here before weather gives anyone an excuse for missing it.

reviewItems.label: Marrick · page 5
reviewItems.candidate: The interval returns closely enough for five people to keep one count. The useful test is what the routine does when the sixth count is missed.

reviewItems.label: Marrick · page 6
reviewItems.candidate: Water meets the route often enough that no one person must carry the group's whole thirst. That is when a provision becomes part of the formation.

reviewItems.label: Oda · page 1
reviewItems.candidate: Set the same weight on both faces. This one keeps its edge and sends the force back through the tool. A housing begins with what refuses to travel.

reviewItems.label: Oda · page 2
reviewItems.candidate: Under the same weight, this seam warms and creeps; the far edge lifts after the near one settles. It carries force by changing shape, not by failing to have one.

reviewItems.label: Oda · page 3
reviewItems.candidate: A sharp report returns from the close walls before the tool stops ringing. The land keeps each disturbance near enough to follow; containment is evidence, not innocence.

reviewItems.label: Ashe · volatile-ground page
reviewItems.candidate: Hold pressure in one place and the ground answers somewhere else: grit lifts, a crack runs, heat reaches the sole. It carries force instead of merely holding it.

reviewItems.label: Wren · open-routes page
reviewItems.candidate: The ground stays open far enough to hold several routes in sight at once. Keep seeing the others after you decide which line to take.

questions.title: What level should a named traveller join at?
questions.context: Named travellers currently join at level 1 even late in a long campaign. Active members then earn the same XP, so the gap never closes naturally. Encounter scaling correctly does not lower foe level to protect a recruit, which can leave a late arrival permanently fragile or unusable.
questions.recommendation: Have each named traveller join at the Binder's current level. Recruitment is already a major earned reward, and immediate parity lets the new person be played instead of parked. Their authored calling lean remains a bonus, while all level-earned combat points arrive unspent so the player chooses the build.

choices.title: Match Binder level
choices.detail: Join immediately usable at the Binder's current level, with level points banked and authored lean preserved.

choices.title: Two levels behind
choices.detail: Join slightly behind and add accelerated XP until the traveller reaches the Binder; more growth texture, but another persistent rule.

choices.title: Level 1 with catch-up
choices.detail: Preserve a full growth arc but grant strongly accelerated XP; late recruits may still need to sit out initially.

choices.title: Keep level 1
choices.detail: Accept that late named travellers begin far behind and require ordinary equal-share XP to advance.
